teaser: Seven architectures for agents on ephemeral vaults, a recipe repository that gates sgit's releases, and a hundred writers measured on an append lane.
core_idea: Agents that work together can use an ephemeral encrypted vault as shared memory, channel and record, with keys deciding who can do what and only ciphertext leaving the environment; seven architectures from one agent to a swarm, each answering memory, communication, asynchrony and visibility, belong in their own repository of forkable recipes with CI jobs that gate sgit's releases, watched by vault apps; measured locally, a hundred writers landed a thousand append-lane entries in 4.9 seconds with none lost, scoped clones scaled while full clones queued, and four defects surfaced that make the case for the gate.
